expected_behavior: Finish every turn; an observational-memory observer call completing in the background must not end the active ACP prompt or terminate the ACP server.

rounds.evidence: All 10 steps succeeded with tool calls and replies. No cancelled step and no 'ACP adapter is closed'. Two OM observer calls (one completed 200 mid-session without a cancel). 32x200 + 1 'Client disconnected' at session end. Judge pass.
All 10 steps succeeded with tool calls and replies; no cancel. One OM call, still open at session end ('Client disconnected'). 27x200. Judge issue for unrelated reasons.
